title: Finish a half-done feature in the Rust crate `crates/ui/aura-ui-terminal` (ratatui TUI): a clickable "⧉ Copy" button in…
summary: The feature code is finished, but none of the new tests have been run. After my edits the crate stopped building because of other uncommitted work (a `typing_timings` function defined twice in `renderer/bench.rs`, and an `archived_at_ms` field `app/archive.rs` uses that `AgentSummary` doesn't have). I didn't touch either file. I also didn't get to `cargo fmt -p aura-ui-terminal`.
